why: Resolve the low-vegetation readability concern at overview scale using the actual shared renderer and all native nature entries.
identity: All 21 board pixels and all recorded sources independently rehashed after individual inspection.
findings: No additional target clipping, detached ground contact, opaque sprite ground island or proportion mismatch was observed against the original home, road and Iara references in these controlled static scenes.

Minimum low vegetation is difficult to distinguish at overview zoom. Fine repeated Cerrado and Caatinga ground detail competes with target vegetation, establishing a terrain visual-hierarchy correction to pursue.

A renderer-only sixteen-cell regional texture trial made painted grass oversized; reverted. A separately generated calmer texture reduced grain but introduced visible repeated diagonal bands; excluded from gameplay pending refinement.
limits: No overall visual acceptance. Overview night/rain, close weather, mixed habitats and neighboring clusters remain open.
Source captures are controlled static art comparisons, not ecological suitability or desktop performance evidence.
A small low plant need not be individually identifiable at overview distance; do not distort native plant scale to compensate for terrain noise.
